prompt:
Solve the running-time recurrence below.

```formula essential
T(n) = 2T(n/2) + n^2
where
T: the running time on input size n
n: the input size
In words: Two half-size calls are followed by quadratic outside work.
```

Assume bounded positive base-case costs and the usual integer rounding of fractional child sizes.

options.explanation: Correct. The critical exponent is one; quadratic outside work is larger by a full power, and children together cost half the parent’s outside work.
This incorrectly keeps quadratic work unchanged on every level. The actual level totals halve.
That is the linear-outside-work case. In this recurrence, the root alone already performs quadratic work.
The geometric series is bounded by twice its first term.

workedExample: Each half-size child contributes a quarter of the parent’s quadratic outside work. Two children therefore halve the level total. The decreasing geometric series stays within a constant multiple of the root’s work, which also provides a matching lower bound. Thus the total is Θ(n²).
